scene_prompt: Suspicious moving rain: SMALL adolescent black-and-tan Yorkshire with upright ears playfully chasing a curving spray of water being poured from a watering-can spout over garden beds at the family farm. His body in a little turning/chase-tail pose, looking surprised at droplets, whole dog visible. Include watering-can spout at edge and bright arcing droplets so it reads as watering, not natural storm. Farm cottage terracotta roof, green crops wooden fence, sunshine.
